# DR-SUGAR

Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening for resource-constrained environments.

## Features
- Deep Learning AI for Retinopathy detection
- Real-time screening dashboard
- Clinical validation reporting

- Home: https://drsugar.app/
- Dashboard: https://drsugar.app/dashboard
- Screening: https://drsugar.app/screening
- Privacy Policy: https://drsugar.app/privacy
- Terms: https://drsugar.app/terms
